description: Bounded source-shaped vector update with a dependent conditional from TSVC s273.

pinned_source.attribution: The TSVC source comments attribute its non-four-digit codelets to David Callahan, Jack Dongarra, and David Levine, Test Suite for Vectorizing Compilers.
pinned_source.license_note: No explicit license grant was found in the pinned TSVC source or repository material reviewed. Ports are independent implementations of the bounded loop behavior; no upstream source code or comments are reused and no upstream license or endorsement is claimed.

contract.operation: For each pass and ascending i, update A[i] by D[i]*E[i], conditionally update B[i] if the new A[i] is negative, then update C[i] by the new A[i]*D[i].
contract.arithmetic_type: The source uses binary64 double. Bounded inputs and all intermediates are exact integers below 2^53; the ports use signed i64 arithmetic.
contract.traversal: Passes ascend; within each pass, i ascends. The condition tests A after its update; C then uses this same updated A.
contract.output: Sum of final A, B, and C entries.
contract.success_result: The final checksum as signed i64.

input.encoding: n, passes, then five contiguous arrays A through E, each of length n
